title: Mod Menu Custom Character Configuration
description: Schema for defining custom character properties in the mod menu

renderType.description: The render type for the character asset

scale.description: Size of the character relative to the original size (e.g., 2.0 makes it twice as big)

offsets.description: Global offset to the character's position in pixels [horizontal, vertical]

atlasSettings.description: Settings for the texture atlas (only available for animateatlas render type)

animations.description: List of animation data objects for the character

name.description: Animation name used by the game

prefix.description: Animation frame prefix in the sprite asset

hasCustomWires.description: Whether the character has custom wire animations

useSmallWire.description: Use the small wire variant (used for Pinhead) instead of the regular one

smokeOffsets.description: Offsets for the character's smoke trail during the crispy animation [horizontal, vertical]

smokeScale.description: Scale of the character's smoke trail during the crispy animation [x-scale, y-scale]
